nextStoryContext: US-FIX-004 done. isSessionStale now identifies the 3rd pane by finding the pane whose label is NOT 'orchestrator' or 'dashboard', then checks if its label is in WORKER_LABELS ('implementer' or 'reviewer'). Stray/unlabeled 3rd panes correctly return stale=true. Tests rewritten to production-realistic fixtures (orchestrator + dashboard always labeled). 912 tests pass. Check prd.json for the next pending story.
